edges.effect_quant: Randomized trials suggest the direction is more reliable than any single pooled magnitude.
edges.population: adults taking levothyroxine near iron dosing
edges.mechanism: This drug-related edge is biologically plausible because the medication changes absorption, excretion, endocrine signaling, or tissue turnover in a predictable direction. Duration, dose, and co-medication use usually determine whether the effect becomes clinically relevant for Thyroid control.
edges.summary: In adults taking levothyroxine near iron dosing, randomized trials suggest that iron tracks with worse thyroid control. Most disagreement in the literature is about size, subgroup sensitivity, or dose threshold rather than about whether the relationship exists at all.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
